// Writes genuine E1b (1e8db0b) plugin states to disk, for the E1b.1
// effective-Q fixtures.
#include "plugin/PluginProcessor.h"
#include "parameters/ParameterIDs.h"

static void setParam (labq8::LabQ8AudioProcessor& p, const char* id, float v)
{
    auto* param = p.getValueTreeState().getParameter (id);
    param->setValueNotifyingHost (param->convertTo0to1 (v));
}

static void dump (labq8::LabQ8AudioProcessor& p, const juce::File& dir, const char* name)
{
    juce::MemoryBlock block;
    p.getStateInformation (block);
    dir.getChildFile (juce::String (name) + ".bin").replaceWithData (block.getData(), block.getSize());
    auto xml = juce::AudioProcessor::getXmlFromBinary (block.getData(), (int) block.getSize());
    dir.getChildFile (juce::String (name) + ".xml").replaceWithText (xml->toString());
}

struct Band
{
    int type;
    float freq, gain, q;
    bool bypass;
};

static void write (const juce::File& dir, const char* name, const Band (&bands)[8])
{
    labq8::LabQ8AudioProcessor p;
    for (int b = 0; b < 8; ++b)
    {
        const auto& ids = labq8::params::bandIDs[(size_t) b];
        setParam (p, ids.type, (float) bands[b].type);
        setParam (p, ids.frequency, bands[b].freq);
        setParam (p, ids.gain, bands[b].gain);
        setParam (p, ids.q, bands[b].q);
        setParam (p, ids.bypass, bands[b].bypass ? 1.0f : 0.0f);
    }
    dump (p, dir, name);
}

int main (int, char** argv)
{
    juce::ScopedJuceInitialiser_GUI init;
    const juce::File dir { juce::String { argv[1] } };
    dir.createDirectory();

    // Types: 0 Bell, 1 Low Shelf, 2 High Shelf, 3 Low Cut, 4 High Cut, 5 Notch.
    // Shelves and cuts above the E1b.1 limits (shelf Q 1, cut Q 2), plus
    // Bell / notch at Q 18 and one shelf and one cut inside the limits.
    const Band highQ[8] = {
        { 1, 80.0f, 6.0f, 18.0f, false },     { 2, 8000.0f, -8.0f, 4.0f, false },
        { 3, 40.0f, 0.0f, 10.0f, false },     { 4, 12000.0f, 0.0f, 2.5f, false },
        { 0, 1000.0f, 3.0f, 18.0f, false },   { 5, 3000.0f, 0.0f, 18.0f, false },
        { 1, 200.0f, -3.0f, 0.8f, false },    { 3, 25.0f, 0.0f, 1.5f, false },
    };
    write (dir, "e1b_high_q", highQ);

    // Every shelf and cut at or below its limit: must sound exactly like E1b.
    const Band withinLimits[8] = {
        { 1, 100.0f, 4.0f, 1.0f, false },     { 2, 6000.0f, -5.0f, 1.0f, false },
        { 3, 30.0f, 0.0f, 2.0f, false },      { 4, 15000.0f, 0.0f, 2.0f, false },
        { 0, 1000.0f, -6.0f, 18.0f, false },  { 5, 60.0f, 0.0f, 18.0f, false },
        { 1, 250.0f, 2.0f, 0.5f, false },     { 4, 18000.0f, 0.0f, 0.7071f, true },
    };
    write (dir, "e1b_within_limits", withinLimits);
    return 0;
}
